Brief.Title: Lava Forest Obby
Brief.Pitch: Leap over glowing lava through a pine forest.
Brief.TargetPlayers: 8-14 year olds who like quick challenges
Brief.CoreLoop: Jump from platform to platform over lava, touching each checkpoint to save progress.
MustHave: A lava floor that resets players

PostMortems.WorkedWell: Short stages kept players moving; 40% reached stage 3.
PostMortems.DidNotWork: Few players bought the VIP pass.
Lessons: Short obby stages with a checkpoint every few jumps keep new players going.
A 149 Robux VIP pass sold poorly in a three-stage obby; offer cheaper boosts first.
